channel.title: Inland Valley Daily Bulletin - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Inland Valley Daily Bulletin (dailybulletin.com)

item.title: This bill would ban ICE agents from future hiring as a public employee in California
item.description: Democrats in the California Legislature have introduced a series of bills to combat ICE.

item.title: Torrance man charged with sending fake ransom demand to Savannah Guthrie’s family is released on $20K bond
item.description: The text messages sent to Guthrie's family were traced to Derrick Callella's home, and he admitted sending them, authorities said.

item.title: Judge orders Trump administration to bring back 3 families deported to Honduras, other countries
item.description: The judge said the government relied on “lies, deception and coercion” to deport them.

item.title: Security concerns and skepticism are bursting the bubble of Moltbook, the viral AI social forum
item.description: Many experts have expressed security concerns about the platform.

item.title: Editorial: There’s no excuse for Trump’s racist social media post
item.description: Americans have gone numb to the ridiculous statements of the president of the United States

item.title: Lakers’ Luka Doncic to sit out vs. Warriors with left hamstring strain
item.description: The NBA’s leading scorer, who has grappled with ankle and groin ailments as well this season, won’t play in Saturday night’s game after his mid-game exit against the 76ers on Thursday.

item.title: San Bernardino County confirms year’s first case of measles
item.description: Possible exposure may have occurred between noon and 3 p.m. Jan. 29 at Walmart Supercenter, 1333 N. Mountain Ave., in Ontario.

item.title: Leader of Hemet-based religious group struck congregant with microphone for disobedience, woman testifies at hearing in double-murder case
item.description: Woman said Shelley 'Kat' Martin, charged with murder along with 4 others, grew more controlling and violent as head of His Way Spirit Led Assemblies.

item.title: No. 1 UCLA men’s volleyball rallies to beat No. 2 Long Beach State in rematch of NCAA final
item.description: The Bruins drop the first two sets and trail late in the third before turning things around for a 16-25, 22-25, 25-22, 25-19, 15-10 win, avenging a loss in last spring’s national championship match.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard, Clippers outlast Kings to begin trip
item.description: Leonard has 31 points and seven assists and John Collins adds 22 points as the Clippers end a two-game skid with a 114-111 win in their first game since trading center Ivica Zubac.
